item.title: Cortisol Memes Continue Evolving Online With The 'Low Cortisol Dance'
item.description: Low Cortisol Dance, also known as Low Cortisol Agnes Tachyon, refers to fan animation of the character Agnes Tachyon from Uma Musume: Pretty Derby dancing to the Vietnamese song "Ai Đưa Em Về" by TIA. The animation became associated with the Cortisol Level meme in early February 2026, depicting Tachyon having a low cortisol level, which inspired users to make variations of other characters doing the dance.

item.title: 1999 'Eddie Murphy' Comedy 'Life' Inspires 'You Gonna Eat Your Cornbread' Meme
item.description: Hey Girl, You Gonna Eat Your Cornbread? is a series of brainrot memes based on a clip from the 1999 comedy film Life where Goldmouth asks Claude, played by Martin Lawrence, if he's going to eat his cornbread. The scene was reposted online numerous times throughout the 2000s and 2020s, going viral on several occasions. In March 2026, the scene became the subject of brainrot edits and memes on TikTok as a niche meme.

item.description: Joe Rogan, Daniel Cormier and Jon Anik UFC #248 Reaction is a reaction image macro series featuring Ultimate Fighting Championship commentators Joe Rogan, Daniel Cormier and Jon Anik reacting to Beneil Dariush knocking out Drakkar Klose during a UFC 248 match.

item.title: 12 Years Ago Today, This Classic Reaction Image Graced The Internet
item.description: Aaron Paul Screaming is a face made by actor Aaron Paul playing Tobey Marshall, in the 2014 film adaptation of the game franchise Need for Speed. It has become a popular reaction image, particularly on Tumblr in situations where it looks like something cute will be hurt.
